questions.question: Verify the family’s move to Moscow: the post gives 1926, while Math-Net.Ru’s biography gives 1925, https://www.mathnet.ru/rus/person11314 . Approve the year in both versions. The record confirms Isaak’s 1965 doctorate; it is not confused with his brother Akiva’s degree.

questions.resolution: The move was corrected to 1925 from Isaak Yaglom’s personal biography in Math-Net.Ru.
